is a system under the management of the Department of Health and Environment, Kuala Lumpur City Hall that manages solid waste and public cleaning activities around Kuala Lumpur. The Department of Health & Environment is responsible for monitoring the health of the citizens of the city as well as working to improve the quality of health of its citizens. In addition, this department is also responsible for resolving complaints related to emergencies.

After the Solid Waste Management and Public Cleansing Act 2007 (Act 672) came into force, all solid waste management and public cleansing works are fully implemented by the Solid Waste Management and Public Cleansing Corporation (SWCorp). However, the Department of Health and Environment, Kuala Lumpur City Hall through the Environment Division is still functioning in receiving and processing public application for solid waste collection and public cleaning services under the administrative area of ​​DBKL. In addition, DBKL is also responsible for ensure the level of cleanliness and comfort of the citizens of the city.
Selepas Akta Pengurusan Sisa Pepejal Dan Pembersihan Awam 2007 (Akta 672) dikuatkuasakan, semua kerja – kerja pengurusan sisa pepejal dan pembersihan awam dilaksanakan sepenuhnya oleh Perbadanan Pengurusan Sisa Pepejal dan Pembersihan Awam (SWCorp). Walaubagaimanapun, Jabatan Kesihatan Dan Alam Sekitar, Dewan Bandaraya Kuala Lumpur melalui Bahagian Alam Sekitar masih lagi berfungsi dalam menerima dan memproses permohonan orang ramai bagi perkhidmatan kutipan sisa pepejal dan pembersihan awam dibawah kawasan pentadbiran DBKL. Di samping itu, DBKL juga bertanggungjawab dalam memastikan tahap kebersihan dan keselesaan warga kota.
